body_html:
So you want to learn the secret sauce of using memes in education? 

 

 

What makes ideas spreadable? How can you use memes in the classroom for literary analysis?

 

How do we do it, inspire others, and not go crazy? How do we keep kids sharing safe content. 

 

There is art to it all. Using memes is more than just throwing a quote on a pic. It is multimodal composition. That is the elephant in the room.

 

When done correctly you can bend minds while reaffirming the everyday literacy practices.
